A clean and simple open source HackerNews client written in typescript using React Native. 

Visit https://github.com/G2Jose/ReactNative-HackerNews to view source

show_hn.title: Show HN: A Hacker News App Built in React Native

quotes.text:
I recently decided to give React Native a go, and made a clean & simple Hacker News app. I've also open sourced the code at https://github.com/G2Jose/ReactNative-HackerNews

I was really impressed with how easy it was to get started, and build an actual cross platform native app using tools & language I already know (JS).

I've published the iOS version of the app at https://itunes.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewSoftware?id=1220272464&mt=8

I'd love to hear your thoughts!
